\noindent stable: 20 populations, 520 (population, sex, origin) units over 13 origin(s), 26000 cell rows of which 6480 error rows are excluded from every mean.\par
\noindent shift: 20 populations, 40 (population, sex, origin) units over 1 origin(s), 2000 cell rows of which 210 error rows are excluded from every mean.\par
\noindent placebo: 11 populations, 22 (population, sex, origin) units over 1 origin(s), 1100 cell rows of which 136 error rows are excluded from every mean.\par
\noindent Descriptive table: no common-cell restriction is applied (addendum 3 \S11 applies to contrasts); $n$ is the number of valid rows entering each mean and $n_{\mathrm{err}}$ the error rows of that cell excluded from it.\par
\noindent Conformal mechanisms (split, EnbPI, copula) construct one interval at 95\%; their 50\%/80\% columns are not applicable (n/a) by design and their CRPS / log score / PIT are placeholders never tabulated as proper scores (addendum 2 \S3).\par
\noindent CBD (M5) is scored on ages 55--99 only; its rows are not comparable with full-age (0--99) families.\par
\noindent Multi-output GP rows come from the second-pass parquet (\texttt{results/<regime>\_gp.parquet}) merged by regime.\par
\noindent $\IS_{95}$: mean Winkler / interval score of the 95\% interval on log rates (negatively oriented).\par
